notes: Synthetic, from the ConverseStreamOutput / ResponseStream unions of the same model (an exception is an event-stream message with :message-type exception and :exception-type <member>, its members as the JSON payload), and the event-stream framing described in contract_eventstream_test.go. modelStreamErrorException is a member of ConverseStreamOutput (ModelStreamErrorException, 424, with originalStatusCode and originalMessage). Not recordable: it reports a failure inside the model. Message, original status and original message invented.

sanity_gaps.reason: known gap B16: a mid-stream exception becomes a 502 upstream_error (code provider_0) whatever the exception, with the raw payload JSON as its message; a modelStreamErrorException is a 424 (a model failure the client is told to retry), so it should not turn into a gateway-side 502
